feature_schema.description: Canonical fixture identity.
feature_schema.formula: Copied from the frozen label row.
feature_schema.name: fixture_identity

feature_schema.description: UTC target kickoff used for the strict temporal cutoff.

feature_schema.description: Target away team.
feature_schema.formula: Frozen label identity.
feature_schema.name: away_team

feature_schema.description: Number of strictly earlier allowed-split team fixtures.
feature_schema.formula: count(prior team fixtures with kickoff < target kickoff)
feature_schema.name: home_team_prior_overall_matches

feature_schema.description: Number of strictly earlier team fixtures at home venue.
feature_schema.formula: count(prior team fixtures at venue=home)
feature_schema.name: home_team_prior_relevant_venue_matches

feature_schema.description: Elapsed days since the latest strictly earlier fixture; blank without history.
feature_schema.formula: (target kickoff - latest prior kickoff) / 86400 seconds
feature_schema.name: home_team_days_since_previous_fixture

feature_schema.description: Explicit indicator that no allowed prior fixture exists.
feature_schema.formula: 1 when prior overall count is 0, otherwise 0
feature_schema.name: home_team_no_prior_history

feature_schema.description: Explicit missingness indicator for days since previous fixture.
feature_schema.formula: 1 when days-since is unavailable, otherwise 0
feature_schema.name: home_team_days_since_previous_missing
